children: Motilal Oswal's research report on SBI Cards

SBI Cards (SBICARD) reported 2QFY27 PAT of INR7.8b (up 75% YoY/17% QoQ, 9% beat), led by lower-than-expected provisions. NIM contracted 1bp QoQ to 10.8% (vs 10.7% MOFSLe), while NII growth of 3% QoQ was in line with MOFSLe. SBICARD expects NIM to remain broadly stable despite upward pressure on borrowing costs from the recent repo rate hike.
We raise our earnings estimates by 5-6% and expect SBICARD to deliver FY28E RoA/RoE of 4.5%/18.4%. Reiterate Neutral with a revised TP of INR625 (16x FY28E EPS).
